name: Protective Line [Combat, Selfless, Teamwork]
body:
You look out for your teammates while they reload.

Prerequisite(s): Exotic Weapon Proficiency (firearms).

Benefit(s): When you are adjacent to an ally, they do not provoke attacks of opportunity while loading a firearm.
